parameters.name: BackupRetentionPeriod
parameters.description: The number of days to retain backups.

parameters.name: PreferredBackupPeriod
parameters.description: The backup cycle. Specify the days of the week for backups. Separate multiple days with commas (`,`).

parameters.name: PreferredBackupTime
parameters.description: The UTC time range to perform the backup. For example, `12:00Z-13:00Z` means that the backup starts between 12:00 and 13:00 UTC.
